findings.location: Paragraph beginning "Eunice was a Jewess..." (source.html) — proper name
findings.source_quote: We read that unfeigned faith was first wrought in her mother Lois, and that affected Eunice.
findings.suggested_fix:
Restore the mother's name to match the authoritative English: translate "Lois" as "Lois" (use conventional Spanish spelling only if the author used it; here the author printed "Lois"). Example revision (preserve surrounding HTML tags):

...Leemos que la fe sincera fue primeramente obrada en su madre Lois, y eso afectó a Eunice.
findings.translation_quote: Leemos que la fe sincera fue primeramente obrada en su madre Loida, y eso afectó a Eunice.

findings.source_quote: Our impotency is not caused due to the lack of God’s power, but because our dim understanding is infested and infiltrated with the influences of this present world.
findings.suggested_fix:
Correct target-language grammatical agreement and natural phrasing. Replace "nuestra entendimiento tenue" with "nuestro entendimiento tenue" or preferably "nuestro entendimiento limitado" for clarity. Example revision (preserve surrounding HTML tags):

Nuestra impotencia no se debe a la falta del poder de Dios, sino a que nuestro entendimiento limitado está infestado e infiltrado por las influencias de este mundo presente.
findings.translation_quote: Nuestra impotencia no se debe a la falta del poder de Dios, sino a que nuestra entendimiento tenue está infestado e infiltrado por las influencias de este mundo presente.
